Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that requests speaker diarization for a recorded meeting using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import os
import speech_to_text_v2
from ibm_cloud_sdk_core.authenticators import IAMAuthenticator

# Initialize the Speech to Text service
authenticator = IAMAuthenticator('YOUR_API_KEY')
service = speech_to_text_v2.SpeechToTextV1(authenticator=authenticator)
service.set_service_url('https://api.us-south.speech-to-text.watson.cloud.ibm.com')

# Define the audio file and transcription options
with open('meeting_recording.wav', 'rb') as audio_file:
    response = service.recognize(
        audio=audio_file,
        content_type='audio/wav',
        diarization=True,
        speaker_labels=True,
        audio_language='en-US'
    ).get_result()

# Print the transcription result
print(response)
```
